description_short: A story-driven action RPG following Rex and Pyra across the Titans of Alrest in search of Elysium.
description_ar: قاد ريكس وبايرا ورفاقهما عبر عالم ألريست بحثًا عن Elysium. استكشف العمالقة الأحياء، واجمع الـBlades وطوّرها، وأتقن نظام قتال متدرج وعميق، مع توسعة رسمية كبيرة تتضمن Torna ~ The Golden Country.
nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: Nintendo Switch version released 2017-12-01. Native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition released digitally on 2026-07-30; Nintendo lists 4K TV / full-HD handheld at 60 fps plus MOMO, Merc Assault and new Pyra/Mythra outfit designs.

gameplayPillars.title: Driver and Blade combat
gameplayPillars.description: Drivers fight alongside Blades, combining Arts, Specials, elemental routes, Driver Combos, Blade Combos, and Chain Attacks.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore the Titans
gameplayPillars.description: The Titans function as large adventure regions filled with quests, enemies, collection points, landmarks, towns, and hidden paths.

gameplayPillars.title: Build affinity and teams
gameplayPillars.description: Blade affinity charts, equipment, Aux Cores, pouch items, roles, elements, and party composition create a large customization layer.

worldSummary: Alrest is a cloud-covered world where civilizations live on the backs of enormous Titans. Each Titan has distinctive terrain, settlements, wildlife, politics, and routes that change the shape of exploration.

storyChapters.title: Rex and Pyra
storyChapters.body: Rex forms a bond with Pyra and accepts her request to reach Elysium, drawing him into a conflict involving Drivers, Blades, and rival powers.

storyChapters.title: The search for Elysium
storyChapters.body: The party journeys between Titans as dwindling land and political tension push Alrest toward crisis.

storyChapters.title: Conflict over Alrest’s future
storyChapters.body: The search for Elysium reveals deeper truths about Blades, Titans, and the history that shaped Alrest.

features: Large regions built on living Titans
Elemental combos, Chain Attacks, and affinity progression
Rare Blade collection and affinity charts
perfNotes: Original Switch: docked 720p with a 30 fps target and occasional dips; handheld uses aggressive dynamic resolution roughly 368p-552p. Switch 2 Edition: official 4K TV / 1080p handheld output at 60 fps; measured internal resolution is lower and temporally upscaled.
storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.2 GB for the Switch game and 37.6 GB for the Switch 2 Edition.

verdictSummary: A large, ambitious JRPG with a memorable cast, expansive world design, and an unusually deep combat/build system. The Switch 2 Edition substantially improves image clarity and frame rate.

timeline.title: Torna ~ The Golden Country expansion
